description: Header file defining the FdkAacAudioDecoder class for AAC audio decoding using libfdkaac, including class members, methods, and constants.

classes.name: FdkAacAudioDecoder
classes.description: Class implementing AAC audio decoding using libfdkaac, managing decoding process, buffers, and stream info.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with output and error callbacks.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves decoded audio data and samples per second.

methods.name: WriteToFdkDecoder
methods.description: Feeds input buffer data into the libfdkaac decoder.

methods.name: ReadFromFdkDecoder
methods.description: Reads decoded data from the decoder.

methods.name: TryToUpdateStreamInfo
methods.description: Updates stream info from the decoder.
